metadata.title: Chris Olave Remains a Must-Start WR1 Despite Tough Matchup
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave hauled in eight receptions for 116 yards on 12 targets in Week 4's loss to the Falcons. He got off to a slow start, recording no catches through most of the first quarter, before quarterback Tyler Shough connected with him on a 44-yard deep ball to get him going. Olave now ranks second in the league in both receptions (35) and receiving yards (491). He also appeared on the injury report this week with a foot issue, but practiced in full on Friday and is officially good to go against Minnesota. Olave remains the focal point of the Saints' offense, and despite a tough matchup against the Vikings, he remains a weekly must-start WR1. He ranks as WR7 in RotoBaller's Week 5 rankings.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Good to go Sunday
metadata.description: Olave (foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.
metadata.analysis: After being limited Thursday due to a foot issue, Olave's full participation Friday clears up his status for Week 5. The NFL's leader in targets (48) has a tough test against Minnesota's aggressive defense, but the Saints can't run the ball and have been forced to dial up the pass at a high clip through four games. Olave is a lock-and-load WR1 every week.

metadata.title: Chris Olave (foot) off injury report Sunday
metadata.description: Chris Olave is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
metadata.analysis: Olave was able to practice on both Thursday and Friday. He will remain a WR1 play for fantasy managers.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Practicing again Friday
metadata.description: Olave (rest/foot) appeared to be moving well during the part of Friday's practice open to the media, Jeff Nowak of WWL New Orleans reports.
metadata.analysis: After being rested for Wednesday's walkthrough, Olave was limited at Thursday's session due to a foot injury. His status for Sunday's game against the Vikings may receive some clarity once the Saints post their final Week 5 practice report Friday.

metadata.title: Chris Olave (foot) practices Friday
metadata.description: Chris Olave was at practice again on Friday.
metadata.analysis: Olave was limited in practice on Thursday. He remains on track to be good to go despite leaving the Saints last game late.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Ready to Go For Week 5
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave (foot) was a full participant in Friday's practice and does not carry an injury designation into the Week 5 game on Sunday against the visiting Minnesota Vikings, according to Saints reporter Jeff Nowak. Olave popped up on the team's injury report on Thursday after he had his foot stepped on during practice, according to head coach Kellen Moore. The matchup this weekend for the Saints and Olave is not an easy one against the blitz-happy Vikings defense, but the 26-year-old is a no-brainer must-start WR1 in fantasy when he is healthy. Olave, a former first-rounder in 2022 from Ohio State, has caught 35 of his 48 targets for 491 yards (league-high 122.8 yards per game) and one touchdown to begin his fifth year in the NFL. He has a lot of chemistry with second-year quarterback Tyler Shough in a pass-happy offense and should continue to be heavily targeted this weekend.

metadata.title: Chris Olave (foot) officially limited Thursday
metadata.description: Chris Olave (foot) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Olave is now being listed with a foot issue that left him limited at practice on Thursday. It doesn't seem to be a major issue for the star wideout, but fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his status heading into the weekend to make sure he's going to suit up, play, and see a full workload against the Vikings this weekend.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Dealing with foot issue
metadata.description: Olave (rest/foot) practiced in a limited capacity Thursday.
metadata.analysis: The Saints held a walkthrough Wednesday, during which Olave logged a rest day. As of Thursday, he mixed back into drills, but a foot injury was added to the practice report after his capped session. His ability to handle some reps while dealing with a health concern generally is a good sign that his status isn't in question for Week 5, but Friday's injury report will reveal whether or not he enters the weekend with a designation for Sunday's contest versus the Vikings.

metadata.title: Chris Olave participating at practice Thursday
metadata.description: Chris Olave was seen participating at New Orleans' practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Fantasy managers are still waiting to see if Olave will have any injury designation for Week 5 after seemingly suffering a lower body injury of some kind in Monday night's loss to the Falcons. It's a good sign that he was seen participating at practice on Thursday, but we won't know his official injury designation until the team released their official practice report.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Returns to practice Thursday
metadata.description: Olave was present and involved throughout Thursday's practice, Ross Jackson of LouisianaSports.net reports.
metadata.analysis: Olave rested Wednesday after catching eight of 12 targets for 116 yards in Monday's loss to the Falcons. The star wide receiver returned to practice Thursday, assuaging any lingering concerns about his health. Olave will look to add to his season totals of 35 catches for 491 yards and one touchdown Sunday against the Vikings.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Limited in Practice on Thursday with Foot Injury
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave (foot) was limited in practice on Thursday with a foot injury, per Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football. Olave did not practice on Wednesday, which the team described as a rest day. However, it appears as though the 26-year-old could actually be dealing with an injury that may impact his availability for the Saints' Week 5 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings. Olave has been one of the most productive wide receivers in football so far this season, recording 35 catches for 491 yards and a touchdown on 48 targets across four games. He's recorded double-digit targets in every game and 100 receiving yards in three out of four contests. If Olave is unable to play against Minnesota, Saints wide receiver Devaughn Vele and tight end Juwan Johnson could vault into must-start territory for fantasy managers.

metadata.title: Chris Olave (rest) absent from practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Chris Olave (rest) was absent from New Orleans' practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Olave had a slight injury scare at the end of Monday night's game, but he is not listed with any injury at this point and only missed Wednesday's practice as a rest day. That means that he should be good to go for Week 5, which is great news for fantasy managers of the star wideout.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Gets rest day Wednesday
metadata.description: Olave had a rest day at Wednesday's practice, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: The Saints had a walkthrough Wednesday after having played Monday night against the Falcons. Olave was given a rest day, and according to Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football, it was unrelated to a hard shot he took during the loss to the Falcons. Olave does not appear to be dealing with an injury, and should return to practice later in the week.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Not on Week 5 Injury Report
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave was rested in practice on Wednesday but was not listed with an injury designation, according to Saints sideline reporter Jeff Nowak. Olave took a hard shot in the Monday night loss to the Atlanta Falcons to close out Week 4, but his absence on Wednesday was not related to that hit. The 26-year-old should be just fine to play this weekend against the visiting Minnesota Vikings on Sunday, and he should be locked into all starting fantasy lineups despite the difficult matchup against the Vikings' defense. The former first-rounder is the team's unquestioned WR1 and has a great connection with second-year quarterback Tyler Shough. After reaching the third 1,000-yard season of his career in 2025 with a career-best nine touchdowns, Olave leads the NFL in targets (48) through four games in 2026 and has added 35 receptions for 491 yards and one touchdown to begin his fifth year in the league. He already has three 100-yard games this season after catching eight of 12 targets for 116 yards on Monday night. Olave has at least 10 targets in all four games in 2026.

metadata.title: Chris Olave leads team in receiving Monday
metadata.description: Chris Olave caught 8-of-12 targets for 116 yards in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
metadata.analysis: Olave was a bright spot for the Saints on Monday, leading the team in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in their loss to the Falcons. It briefly looked like he suffered a lower-body injury at the end of the game, but it sounds like he will be just fine, although it would still be smart for fantasy managers to monitor his status at practice throughout the week.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Stellar numbers in lopsided loss
metadata.description: Olave secured eight of 12 targets for 116 yards in the Saints' 45-24 loss to the Falcons on Monday night.
metadata.analysis: Olave was in the customary position of leading the Saints in receptions, receiving yards and targets, putting together his third 100-yard effort, including his second straight, of 2026. He also extended his season-opening streak of games with double-digit targets to four, and although Jeff Nowak of WWLAM-FM reports the talented receiver took a hit to the knee on New Orleans' final drive and went to the sideline, he never entered the medical tent. Assuming Olave is no worse for wear, he'll once again be slated for a prominent role in a Week 5 home matchup against the Vikings on Sunday.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Set for Another Strong Showing in Week 4 Against Falcons
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave continued his hot start to the season, recording nine receptions for 107 yards in Week 3 against the Raiders. Through three games, Olave has 375 receiving yards, which ranks second in the league, while doing so on a 75.0% catch rate. He has been the focal point of the Saints' passing attack, tying for the league lead in both targets (36) and receptions (27). Olave has clearly developed strong chemistry with second-year starter Tyler Shough, making him one of the most reliable options in the Saints' offense. He now faces a Falcons defense allowing 263 passing yards per game, 29th in the league, setting up another favorable matchup in Week 4. Olave remains a weekly must-start and comes in as WR4 in RotoBaller's Week 4 rankings.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Re-Establishing Himself as a Fantasy WR1
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave has strengthened his fantasy value with another heavy-volume performance in Week 3. Olave caught nine of 13 targets for 107 yards against Las Vegas, giving him at least eight receptions and 86 receiving yards in all three games this season. He has already drawn 36 targets, turning them into 27 catches for 375 yards and one touchdown. The touchdown total is modest, but the workload has been anything but. Olave has led the Saints in targets every week, and Tyler Shough continues to look his way at a high rate regardless of game script. That combination of volume and production has pushed Olave back into the top tier at the position, with RotoBaller ranking him WR4 in its early Week 4 half-PPR rankings. New Orleans hosts Atlanta on Monday night, but the bigger fantasy takeaway is that Olave's role has been both large and remarkably consistent through the first three weeks.

metadata.title: Chris Olave records 107 yards Sunday
metadata.description: Chris Olave caught 9-of-13 targets for 107 yards in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Olave continues to lead the Saints in receiving on a week in and week out basis. He is a WR1 moving forward for fantasy managers with his involvement to start the season.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Tops century mark again Sunday
metadata.description: Olave caught nine of 13 targets for 107 yards in Sunday's 35-27 loss to the Raiders.
metadata.analysis: The fifth-year wideout led the Saints in catches, targets and receiving yards, but all four of Tyler Shough's TD passes went to tight ends instead of Olave. Olave has hauled in more than 100 yards in two of three games to begin the season, amassing a 27-375-1 line on 36 targets, and he'll look to keep rolling in Week 4 at home against the Falcons.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Remains a High-End WR1 Option in Week 3
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave has gotten off to an excellent start to the 2026 season, catching 18 passes for 268 yards and a touchdown on 23 targets in his first two games. The 26-year-old has established himself as the clear number one option in a Saints passing game that is ascending in quarterback Tyler Shough's first full season as the starter. In Week 3, Olave and the Saints will take on the Las Vegas Raiders. The Raiders have defended well against the pass so far, giving up just one passing touchdown and ranking 10th in the NFL in total passing yards allowed (412). However, the Saints have attempted the second-most passes in the league through two weeks. If New Orleans continues to operate with a pass-heavy game script, Olave is a lock to see a high volume of targets and a good bet to produce for fantasy managers. In Week 3 against Las Vegas, Olave remains a solid fantasy WR1.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Among the Elite Tier of Fantasy Football Wide Receivers
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave has emerged as one of the most elite fantasy contributors through the first two weeks of the 2026 NFL season. Olave has at least 22.8 PPR points in each of the two games. With a total of 18 catches, 268 yards, and one touchdown, he ranks as the overall WR3 in PPR leagues so far. We've seen Olave deliver high-level fantasy production in a variety of ways, including high volume, high yardage totals, and touchdown upside. That's good news for fantasy managers, because he's not dependent on one specific stat (catches, yards, or touchdowns) to carry his entire fantasy stock. The Saints' passing attack looks really good this year, and Olave is the focal point of that unit. He continues to rank as a mid-to-high WR1 heading into a very favorable matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders.

metadata.title: Chris Olave finds the end zone in Week 2 win
metadata.description: Chris Olave caught 8-of-10 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in the Saints 24-17 win over the Ravens.
metadata.analysis: Olave was considered questionable to play due to a hamstring injury, but that did not appear to impact him at all against the Ravens. Olave caught a 21-yard touchdown pass in the fourth quarter to tie the game and help pace the Saints to the upset win. Olave will look to continue his strong start to the season in Week 3 against Las Vegas.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Big day in upset of Ravens
metadata.description: Olave caught eight of 10 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-17 win over Baltimore.
metadata.analysis: The fifth-year wideout dealt with a minor hamstring issue during the week, but Olave looked fully healthy when he hauled in a 21-yard strike from Tyler Shough early in the fourth quarter to tie the game at 17-17. Olave has an impressive 18-268-1 line on 23 targets through two games as the Saints' clear top downfield option, and he seems likely to continue padding his numbers in a Week 3 home tilt against the Raiders.

metadata.title: Chris Olave (hamstring) officially active for Week 2
metadata.description: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 2 matchup with the Ravens.
metadata.analysis: Olave was a late addition to the injury report this week and was listed as questionable to play in Week 2. He immediately becomes the top pass catching option for QB Tyler Shough and the Saints.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Suiting up in Week 2
metadata.description: Olave (hamstring) is listed as active Sunday at Baltimore, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.
metadata.analysis: Olave made an early exit from Thursday's practice due to a hamstring injury, but it was considered a precautionary measure at the time, per Underhill. Olave remained limited Friday and entered the weekend listed as questionable for Week 2 action, but Adam Schefter of ESPN reported Sunday morning that the wide receiver was slated to play. Prior to being confirmed as active, Olave was expected to have no limitations on his workload, according to Underhill, a reality that amounted to 10 catches (on 13 targets) for 182 yards in a season-opening overtime loss in Detroit.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Officially Active for Week 2
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave (hamstring) is officially active for the Week 2 game on Sunday on the road against the Baltimore Ravens, according to Matthew Paras of The New Orleans Times-Picayune. Olave was removed from practice early this week as a precaution due to a hamstring injury, but he returned on Friday and will play this weekend. Fantasy managers will want to keep the Saints' WR1 locked into their starting lineups, even against a tough Ravens defense in their home opener. In the Week 1 season-opening overtime loss to the Detroit Lions on the road, the former first-rounder caught 10 of his 13 targets for 182 yards. Olave has developed excellent chemistry with young quarterback Tyler Shough and should once again be heavily targeted on Sunday, as long as he does not have a setback with his hamstring.

metadata.title: Chris Olave (hamstring) expected to play against Baltimore
metadata.description: Chris Olave (hamstring) is expected to play on Sunday against Baltimore.
metadata.analysis: This is great news for the Saints, who are already down Jordyn Tyson. If Olave sits, Devaughn Vele and Juwan Johnson would be the primary options for Tyler Shough in the passing game. They're worth starting whether or not Olave plays, but the extra defensive attention given to them if he sits could cap their ceilings a little.

metadata.title: Chris Olave - Expected to play Sunday
metadata.description: Olave (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, is on track to play, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
metadata.analysis: Olave took a designation into Sunday after closing Week 2 prep with a pair of practices due to the hamstring injury he sustained during Thursday's session. According to Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football, Olave made the trip to Baltimore with his teammates, and barring a setback in pregame warmups, he'll be formally cleared to play upon the release of the Saints' inactive list approximately 90 minutes prior to the 1 p.m. ET kickoff. Underhill adds that Olave isn't expected to face any limitations in terms of snaps.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Expected to Play in Week 2 Without Limitations
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave (hamstring) is expected to play in Sunday's Week 2 contest against the Baltimore Ravens without any limitations, according to Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football. Olave is officially listed as questionable, and although he missed practice on Thursday, Underhill reports that his absence was purely precautionary. Having Olave available is great news for the Saints. For starters, they're already without Jordyn Tyson (hamstring), so they couldn't afford to lose another receiver for this game against a top AFC opponent. Additionally, Olave is an enormous playmaking threat, as he caught 10 passes for 182 yards in Week 1. He continues to rank as a flashy WR1 option for Sunday's battle with Baltimore.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Travels With Team to Baltimore
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave (hamstring) traveled with the team to Baltimore ahead of Sunday's game, according to Nick Underhill. Olave remains questionable after the hamstring issue surfaced late in the week. He was added to the injury report Thursday and was limited in both Thursday and Friday's practices. Making the trip keeps him in play for Sunday, but it doesn't change the designation. Olave opened the season with 10 catches for a career-high 182 yards on 13 targets against Detroit. Fantasy managers should still have a backup plan ready with his status likely to come down closer to kickoff.

metadata.title: Chris Olave Remains a Must-Start If Active Against Ravens
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Chris Olave (hamstring) went off against the Lions in Week 1, recording 10 receptions for 182 yards on 13 targets in the overtime loss. It was an encouraging sign for fantasy managers who drafted him in the early rounds, as Olave and quarterback Tyler Shough have continued to build on the strong chemistry they showed throughout the 2025 season. Those same managers will need to monitor his status for Week 2's clash against the Ravens closely, as Olave popped up on the injury report Thursday for "precautionary reasons" with a hamstring injury. The questionable tag has followed him to the Saints' final injury report, and his status will be worth watching ahead of Sunday. If he is unable to suit up, receivers Devaughn Vele, Barion Brown and Bryce Lance would be next up. If active, Olave is a must-start WR1 this week.
